title: Grandstream GXP2160 High End HD IP Phone

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GXP2160 High-End HD IP Phone is a premium enterprise-grade VoIP phone designed for businesses that require high call volume management, advanced call control features, and crystal-clear HD audio. Featuring support for 6 SIP accounts, 24 programmable BLF/speed dial keys, integrated Bluetooth, PoE, and dual Gigabit network ports, the GXP2160 is an ideal solution for receptionists, office administrators, call centers, and busy professionals. Its vibrant 4.3-inch color LCD display and intuitive user interface enhance productivity and streamline communication in modern business environments.


Key Features

  • Supports up to 6 SIP accounts and 6 lines
  • Large 4.3-inch (480×272) color TFT LCD display
  • 24 dual-color BLF/speed dial keys for efficient call monitoring
  • Built-in Bluetooth for wireless headset and mobile device connectivity
  • Dual Gigabit Ethernet ports with integrated PoE
  • HD audio on handset and speakerphone for superior voice quality
  • 5-way audio conferencing
  • USB port for data import/export and headset support
  • Advanced security with TLS and SRTP encryption
  • Compatible with major SIP-based IP PBX platforms
  • Supports automated provisioning via TR-069 and XML configuration files
